minor.issue: No validation: payment_model='bogus' and merchant_commission_value=-50 accepted (200). Unknown model silently falls back to commission in estimate_earning; negative cut makes driver earning > delivery fee. Use Literal['commission','salary','per_km'], Literal['fixed','percentage'], Field(ge=0) (and le=100 for percentage).

Full-replace semantics: any omitted field resets to DriverInput defaults (vehicle_info '', driver_km_rate 1.0, bonus_threshold 20...). A partial PUT wiped seeded vehicle_info during testing (restored). Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True).

merchant_cut = fee - earning can go negative for per_km/salary (e.g. per_km base 3 + 1.5/km on a 15km trip = 25.5 > 20 fee → merchant_cut -5.5). Clamp or store as a separate 'merchant_cost' field if intended.
Preflight reflects arbitrary Origin (https://evil.example.com) with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Pre-existing; restrict to explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: 'ZENREX' wordmark is truncated to 'ZENR…' on driver map (96px wrap, fontSize 14, letterSpacing 3, paddingHorizontal 10, numberOfLines=1). User explicitly asked the full wordmark to show first. Widen wrap (~120px) / reduce letterSpacing / drop numberOfLines. Ref: src/components/driver/ZenBrand.tsx:44,52-58

In follow mode the car is centered on the full map height (y≈295 of 607) so it sits on the top edge of the active-delivery bottom sheet (starts y≈318); the route ahead and the customer pin are hidden behind the sheet. Use map.setPadding({bottom: sheetHeight}) / easeTo padding or offset so the car sits in the upper third. Ref: backend/static_map.html:79,84,115

English auto-translations wrong: 'بالكيلو' → 'By the kilogram' (merchant card + option), 'سعر الكيلو' → 'Price per kilogram' (driver pay card). Use unambiguous source text 'بالكيلومتر' / 'سعر الكيلومتر'. Ref: app/merchant/drivers.tsx:66,91; app/driver/earnings.tsx:110
ETA unit shows 'd' ('4 d · 2.1 km') in English – minutes abbreviation mistranslated; use 'min'.

integration_issues.issue: /api/map/route is requested twice per mount (two identical route messages posted to the map). Minor wasted call.
